headline: Diesel Becomes One Cent More Expensive, While Gasoline Goes Up Three Cents
summary: Albania's Ministry of Industry, Entrepreneurship, Trade and Innovation set maximum fuel prices for Friday, 21 August 2026. Diesel rose one cent to 1.79 euros a liter and gasoline rose three cents to 1.52 euros.
why: Regulated maximum fuel prices pass through to transport costs, inflation and the margins of fuel retailers.
